undertow_change: v0.24.0: 9 candidate containers per ruin with 4-5 lit a day by save seed, seven kinds and four tiers by phase (30% second draw), locked cabinets pried with a crowbar (8 s, loud) or the lockpick talent (4 s, quiet), rare/precious flash and sound, kill drops by kind; three enemy layouts per ruin and phase; seven ruin events from day 2 (trapped survivor escort with crew join, airdrop, corpse pile, storeroom, raider search party, backpacker, walkie-talkie); bloater and faker from day 4, spitter and stalker from day 8, replacing walkers one for one; brute and nurse every 7 days in their ruins (announced the day before), the warehouse guard strengthened from day 4 (front armour, slow turn, uninterruptible swings at 0.7 damage, phase-two charges, keeps to its post); boss bar without popups, doubled first win and trophies for a sixth museum case; radio at 07:00, curfew keeps prowling stalkers off the farm, three daily cards (116 total), the dog growls at fakers; 45 new sound effects; new undertow save field with strict validation, old saves get their own seed, no new save keys
longnight_change: v0.25.0: long nights every 7 days after act 8 (day 7n+3, from two days after the story ends): red date at 08:00, red sky and thunder from 18:00, a warning at 21:00 when away, a scream at 22:00 that brings you home; three waves at 22:00/00:00/02:00 (or 20 s after a wave is cleared) of 10/12/14 with the new infected, max 22 alive, the third with a brute or nurse when it thins (0.8 HP); held at 04:00 or when everything is down, failed by going down (nothing lost beyond the usual death rules); x1.2 per night held up to x2; gold, rare draws, three mementos for a seventh museum case, a dawn report with a nap to 08:00, an ending card and archive broadcast after ten; guards stay on past midnight; regular hordes and raids moved off long nights; Grey Falcon counterattack (scouts on day +5 in a ruin, their map; saboteurs on day +7 at 23:00 planting for 11 s; the last raid on day +10 at 19:00 with the leader 隼头: 360 HP, 14-damage shots, smoke every 12 s that halves your damage and blinds towers and guards, the rest flee when he falls; retry two days after a loss); five origins on new game (farmer, medic, hunter, mechanic, veteran) and new game plus from the settings (blueprints, achievements snapshot, career, one gear piece at full durability, checkpoint first); new longnight save field with strict validation, no new save keys
polish_change: v0.25.0: 147 item icons and the chickens, goat, sheep and dog redrawn in code (4-frame walks); maps baked in a Web Worker (the current map from page open via a small inline script, the others in the background, a dark veil up to 1.5 s if a map is not ready), all 115 modules modulepreloaded (scripts/modulepreload.mjs keeps index.html in sync), old-style district/frontier art drawn only when needed, the farm terrain bake faster with the same pixels, event saves deferred to idle time and the previous save not re-parsed; settings show the last export day, a weekly export reminder after sleeping and a save-failure prompt with an export button
tidy_change: v0.26.0: camp tidy-up from the facility checkup: canner and fish trap retired with full refunds (parcels on the cook fire; the migration water-sample bonus moved from fish traps to rainy-day pond catches), the stall merged into the shipping box as a three-slot listing (one piece every 90 min by day at 1.25x), house work/food policies merged into the overtime and injured-first decrees, the lathe's ammo mode replaced by repair kits, mule cargo bringing one cart back instead of lasting perks, apprentices on the crew card with role retraining; old saves converted once (checkpoint first, toast, next-morning list); three mood tiers from a per-person target (50 + listed reasons, 40% drift a night): low idles 40% of hours and sulks 10% of days, high does one more job 25% of hours and has 20% inspirations at 08:00 (lucky harvest, free medkits, everything mended, sharp-eyed towers; trust 3 reveals); 17 facility pages on E with real buttons, five new alerts plus Hemc due dates and the bell; long-night waves at 22:00/00:00/02:00 and the boss at 03:00 with a bell to call them early (two a night, one more rare draw each), waves 12/15/18, traps hit every infected (x1.34, bosses half, raiders spot half), towers only with ready guards (x1.2, lit at night, grey on the defence view), the noise lure sounded by hand (96 minutes, 5 power or a part), the repair post only in fights with a tally; tomorrow's shipping price; Hemc installments due every 3 days with lateness fees and a 7-day refusal; lathe rush with 20% jams; new tidy save field with strict validation, no new save keys
bounty_change: v0.27.0: farming round two plus the farm part of the camp plan. Water network: the well (10 a day), rain barrels (4, rain 12, heat 0, store 12 each), the water tower (30, heat 20, old plots only), the canal (12, heat 4, +4 with egrets, a 30-unit reservoir in hold mode; no more hourly kettle drain; old canal level x5 into storage) and the cistern perk (6, store 30) pool at 00:00 and water planted, unripe, unwatered plots route by route in a player-set order (trough, canal, sprinklers 300, barrels 220, tower); sprinklers (the old irrigation station) check their plots hourly 06:00-20:00 and switch off one by one; water page, board line and plot-card route. Care drone (the old drone): 4 lowest-care plots within 300 an hour, bugs/weeds/water/care for 1 power each, harvests and replants only after you are away a full day. Residents farming: with you on the farm they harvest only plots ripe 4 hours, one plot an hour between them, and replant from storage rotating crops. Compost bin (5 inputs, overnight, quick-grow/quality/water-keeping fertiliser), tomato and bean regrowth (3 cuts, 60% later yields), giant radish/potato/pumpkin/corn (2x2 ripe, care 80+, 25% at dawn, 3 hoe hits, 12-16 portions plus a show piece worth 40 at the harvest show), field hybrids (5% per pair, up to 2 a night, two seeds each: 75% trait seeds, 25% new varieties gold radish, winter potato, glow bean), mystery seed packs, a 12-crop collection book (+1 portion per full row); night raids from day 3 (giants or 10+ plots ripe 6 hours: 2-4 infected at 01:00, real fight when awake on the farm, guards/manned towers/the dog/walls/lamps each stop one when asleep), theft from day 4 (plots ripe a full day, 20% at 03:00, footprints; scarecrows, lamps, covers, glow beans, the dog stop it), storm warnings at 18:00 the day before with early harvest above 70% growth, daily-card farm events placed on real plots; the order board by the shipping box (3 orders a day, 2-3 days, 1.5x sale value in materials, 20% mystery packs, trust from three residents, one tear a day; old daily orders retired, accepted ones kept a day), chickens let into the field from the coop card, butterflies/frogs/egrets helping the field, cold snaps every 28 days after act 7 with the greenhouse sheltering plots within 220, Lin's market garden to steal from; new bounty save field with strict validation and a one-time notice for old saves, no new save keys
bustle_change: v0.28.0: the camp plan's third round. Noise meter in the top bar (radio programs 1-2, radio commands 1-3, lathe rush 1, canteen 1, festival 2, the lure 3; settled at 00:00: 4+ brings 3, 6+ 6, 8+ 10 infected with an armoured one or a spitter from day 8; cleared after an attack, halved otherwise; none extra on long-night, horde or raid nights; awake on the farm they come from one side and the guards who ate before midnight man the towers, leftovers flee at 06:00; asleep or away guards, manned towers, the dog at home, a 6+ fence and lit lamps each stop one, the rest hit the weakest fence (40, iron half) or with no fence hurt someone 20% each; the radio's own 4-point pack folded in). Radio commands at the station (scout 3 power/+1/1 day, airdrop 5/+2/3 days with 3-5 items in a visited ruin and 4 guards after 4 hours, gone after 2 days, call the caravan 6/+2/7 days, help 10/+3/4 days: two neighbours with 120 hp and 14 a hit at the gate for the next long night or horde). Hong Shu's trade runs after the act-5 convoy (every 2 days, up to 20 goods, market food x1.2, a visited district medicine/ammo x1.3, a visited frontier map cloth/parts x1.3, materials back at local buy price and stock, 15% robbed of half, 30% when the noise is 4+ or the Grey Falcons are due, none when you escort it by clearing 4 infected on its map that day; back on day 3 at 08:00). Two-path upgrades (a voucher or an upgrade paper per kind, for good; tower parts 3: searchlight +20% night damage and lights fakers / twin sentry with a spare guard fires twice as fast for 1 bread a day; trap scrap 4: net 3 s / spike +60% and double wear; fence and gate scrap 2: iron takes half / barb 5 a chew, a nearby batch in one go; sprinkler parts 2: far 300 -> 360 / saver 0.7 water; cook fire stone 4: twin two lanes / slow 1.5x time +1 portion; rain barrel cloth 2: big 24 / filter 1.5x in rain); the caravan sells upgrade papers once all blueprints are known. Injuries: a guard on a tower or the gate touched by an infected 20% (once a night), holds the line until the fight ends, then two days off and -10 mood; medicine cabinet (wood 6, cloth 2, parts 1) + bed by a floor = infirmary, bandage a day, medkit by 15:00. Comfort: one point per furniture kind (max 8); the best room within 420 of the farmhouse gives a rested spell of 2 + comfort hours (stamina x1.5, XP +10%); resting residents lose comfort/2 more fatigue; comfort 4 lifts everyone's mood by 2; living standard 3 needs comfort 3; a table makes a dining room (dinner counts one more dish), a bookshelf a study room (apprentices and retraining twice as fast), both count in one room. The canteen served on foot (E at He Dashao's stove, E at the guest, 4-6 guests by reputation, the camp eats there for +5), festival offerings picked by hand (-3/+3/+6/+10), the museum's logs/photos/relics merged into one 往事 case (keepsake furniture or an old map: 2 vouchers, 10 reputation), Jiang Bo staying by the pond with a fish run every 7 days (+1 fish of that kind), Maisui's fifth skill at bond 15 (night patrol: no prowlers, a bark when something comes up behind you on a long night). New bustle save field with strict validation and a one-time notice for old saves (the radio's noise moved onto the meter), no new save keys
almanac_change: v0.29.0: the first of three versions from the Stardew Valley plan (四时 -> 人情 -> 重光), the eleven rhythm-and-land items. A 28-day year of four 7-day seasons (thaw 1-7, heat 8-14, harvest 15-21, cold 22-28), each ending on an existing festival; the top-bar date reads 第 N 天 · season with the year and days left in the tooltip, and opens the festival calendar with a four-season card; in-season crops grow 15% faster and give one extra portion per harvest, off-season ones grow 15% slower (greenhouse exempt), nothing withers; the weather follows a seasonal plan (11 clear, 8 light rain, 4 acid rain, 3 heat, 2 storms a year, no three bad days running, the first three days unchanged); scheduled cold snaps land on day 1 of the cold season (the act-7 one keeps its story day; old saves have the next one moved); half the harvest season's frontier dangers are horde migrations; a seasonal sky tint and three new farm daytime pieces. The 07:00 radio adds tomorrow's weather and Lao Qin's luck draw (great 15%, good 35%, fair 35%, poor 15%, seeded per save: an extra cabinet find 45/35/30/30%, a 25% golden-tail swap at the pond on great days, lockpicking 20% slower and 10% more fake goods from Tang Jiu on poor days) and He Dashao teaches one seasonal dish on the first day of each season. Rain: infected in ruins hear 20% less, prying sounds carry half as far, a full day of rain gives a 35% chance that the camp's noise over the line is masked that night (the noise is halved instead), crafting 10% faster, rain loaches at the pond, mushrooms the day after. Prime crops: in season, care 70+, a fine harvest -> 25% (45% with quality fertiliser) prime, sold at 2.2x, one-for-one in recipes and orders. Pickle jar (stone 4, wood 2; 4 of one vegetable -> 4 pickles after 3 days, aged pickles after 7) and wine jar (stone 3, wood 3; 4 grain or fruit -> 2 country wine after 4 days, aged after 10); wine makes 3 disinfected bandages with cloth and, with 2 pickles, is the vigil's best offering. Coop bonds 0-100 / levels 0-5 for the hens and the goat (pet +6 once a day, fed +4, let out +2, -5 a day untouched): +12% chance of an extra egg per level, goat milk extra from level 4 (15%/30%), a spooked day after infected reach the farm. Four old fruit trees in the residential ruin (mulberry, peach, apple, persimmon) give a cutting every 7 days; grafted on the farm (cutting 1, wood 2, manure 1) they grow in 14 days, bear one fruit a day in their season (up to 3 hanging), improve a grade each new year and lose their branches 25% when infected reach the farm. 24 old ornaments from cabinets (8%, locked 16%) appear in the build menu once owned: indoors a furniture kind (comfort max 9), outdoors +1 camp mood per kind (max +3), sell 6. 4-8 seasonal forage spots a morning on the farm and three visited ruins, unidentified mushrooms after rain (40% upset stomach raw, Dr Xu sorts them); about one good thing per 25 quiet nights (satellite debris, migrating birds, a parcel at the door, radio coordinates to a crate); a three-line ledger card above the scene on waking (shipping box, the night, today), waiting for open pages and skipped on summary mornings. New almanac save field with strict validation and a one-time notice for old saves, ornaments recorded on buildings as decor, no new save keys
kin_change: v0.30.0: the second of three versions from the Stardew Valley plan (四时 -> 人情 -> 重光), the nine people items. Guessed gifts: everyone has 2 loves, 4 likes and 2 dislikes, all unknown at first, learned from the reaction to a gift (+2 / +1 / 0 / -1), the campfire talk about the old days, festival chats, heart talks, door notes and a glance into pockets before pickpocketing; two gifts per person per 7 days, given in person, birthdays doubled; above trust 5 a step takes two portions of goodwill, above 8 three (gifts, campfire talks once per person per 10 days, heart talks, an order-board order once per person per 7 days); 11 keepsakes in the right cabinets of the right ruins (5%, locked 8%). Heart talks for A He, Dr Xu, Chen Gong, Jiang Bo, Granny Qin, Lao Qin, He Dashao and You Ke at trust 3/6/9 on calm evenings at each one's own spot (two answers in talks 1-2 change later lines; talk 2 asks for an old thing at a marked spot in a ruin; talk 3 teaches a skill: seed saving, bandaging, careful repairs, reading the water, mending, starting a song, fire control, saving a part); on the vigil night after the names are read they talk at the plaza; Granny Qin returns ten days after leaving if her talks are unfinished. Door notes from people at trust 4+ (one per person per 7 days, two a day, log and morning ledger only). Festivals: from 16:00 everyone known walks to the plaza for a word each (+3 mood, a taste revealed); seed swap, six lantern-night lamps lit before 20:00 keep the night walkers away, the harvest table, names read at the vigil. Partners among six (A He, Dr Xu, Chen Gong, You Ke, He Dashao, Lao Qin): trust 8 and two heart talks -> a handmade ring or radio; trust 10 and all three -> say it at the fire; next day a feast for the camp (stew 3, field rations 6) -> breakfast every morning and 6 plots watered or the worst facility mended on alternate days; on long nights the partner stands behind you, hits only what comes at them (6 damage per 1.5s, damage only), retreats home at 30% health and is hurt only if felled (2 days, camp mood -8). Children from two travelling mothers (Mei and the new Liu), up to two, learn a craft in 7 days and help daily, eat a ration each evening, stay indoors after dark and in fights. The people page says where everyone is with a marker; idle people sit by the fire in the evening, sandbags at the gate the day before a horde. Maisui brings something home about one morning in three at bond 10+. Reeling: E on a bite starts it, hold to reel, let go when the fish pulls, the line snaps when red (hold 收线 on touch); four waters (the pond, the farm canal, the valley river, the bay) with 24 kinds in the fish book; river and sea water needs Dr Xu's test before eating, two mutant fish for research, waterproof bags 4%; Tang Jiu's caravan adds a rare slot. New kin save field with strict validation and a one-time notice for old saves, no new save keys
relight_change: v0.31.0: the third and last of three versions from the Stardew Valley plan (四时 -> 人情 -> 重光), the seven items about bringing a place back. Rebuild lists: one rebuild station placed anywhere on the farm (wood 20, stone 12, scrap 8), opened with E, 6 walls and 28 lists of things from different sources handed in from the bag and the store (crops of any quality); a full list pays a little, a full wall restores one thing in the ember district: water (+10 water a day), clinic (injuries one day shorter), school (apprentices and retraining twice as fast), radio (a third neighbour answers a call for help), power (lamps from the farm to the market, night walkers reach the farm on half the nights), rail (the road to and from the farm halved); a signal firework once all six walls are filled by hand (the noise goes to the top and every neighbour comes that night); bosses drop their trophy again while a list needs it; a station knocked down is repaired with E. Old world exhibit: 48 old things in 8 groups at the archive, each with its owner's story, a reward per group and a core for all 48; from cabinets of the right ruin and kind (6.2%, locked 12.4%), the tunnel (9.5%, 10 only there), the fallen (0.65%), dig spots and iron boxes (2% / 7% / 4%, opened by Chen Gong for a part: 38% an old thing, 33% a circuit, 29% seeds). Subway tunnel: after the main story and with the hospital lift repaired, the platform in the shelter goes down 30 floors, each laid out from the save seed, floor, day and luck (24x16 tiles, a two-tile track, rooms above and below, the ladder in the farthest room), lifts on 5/10/15/20/25 repaired with carried materials, storerooms on 10/20/30, the pump room on 30 with a core; darker and harder the deeper you go (8 infected a floor, 9 from 21, +1.2% health and +0.7% hit per floor, more armoured and spitters), copper wire, signal bulbs, rail spikes and relays found only there; falling there drags the pack back to the shaft. Pages: 24 from cabinets (2.3%, locked 4.6%, tunnel 2.2%), the fallen (0.4%) and the hook (1.3%): 8 diaries reveal a person's two loves, 8 riddles leave loose earth on a visited map to dig once, 8 water pages in order point to floor 30. Year review: on the vigil night at 21:00 each year a letter scores stores, harvest, mood, nights, lists, old things, trust and cores 0-3 each and lights 1-4 lamps on the plaza stone (raised if missing); the first 4 lamps give the old watch (+3 camp mood) and a core; the collection's 收复度 sums lists, old things, pages, cores, fish, heart talks, tunnel depth and long nights, 100% plays a closing broadcast. Dingfeng Supply: 2000 to sign, then walls for gold (6000-12000, 54000 in all) fixed the next morning; meanwhile a company rule (curfew, a tenth of the harvest), camp mood -5, a crew member asks to leave every 14 days (talk them round with E), no neighbours help, bought walls give no core, the ending card changes; the contract can be torn up (no refund, bought walls stay). Ember cores: 7 (first long night held, floor 30, all 48 old things, all 28 lists by hand, trust 10 with someone, three harvest stars, the first 4-lamp review), each +15 stamina cap and +5 health cap, and each adds 3% to every long-night wave; a monologue card and a notch on the stone. New relight save field with strict validation, a checkpoint and a one-time notice for old saves (cores already earned are granted), caps allowed up to 250 / 200, no new save keys; relight bench, gear-sim tunnel and CORES; 16 new tests
